```{r setup}
#| include: false

## ==============================================================
## Assembles the complete supplement in one render.
##
##   quarto render manuscript/supplement.qmd
##
## Quarto ships inside RStudio rather than on PATH here:
##   & "C:/Program Files/RStudio/resources/app/bin/quarto/bin/quarto.cmd" `
##       render manuscript/supplement.qmd
##
## INPUTS (all produced by scripts in this repo):
##   results/supplement_tables_1_7.rds   <- table scripts/immune-supptables1-7.R
##   results/supplement_tables_8.rds     <- table scripts/immune-sumscore-table.R
##   results/supplement_tables_9_12.rds  <- table scripts/immune-subgroup tables.R
##   results/bangladesh-immune-posthoc-subgroup-results-*.csv <- src/09
##   figures/*.png                       <- figure scripts/
##   manuscript/consort-checklist.csv    <- static, extracted from the v2 docx
##
## Set params$refresh = TRUE (or render with -P refresh:true) to re-run
## the three table scripts before assembling. They are slow, so the
## default reuses whatever is on disk and errors loudly if it is absent.
## ==============================================================

library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(knitr)

source(here("table scripts/_emm_helpers.R"))

set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Times New Roman")

table_scripts <- c(
  "table scripts/immune-supptables1-7.R",
  "table scripts/immune-sumscore-table.R",
  "table scripts/immune-subgroup tables.R"
)

rds_paths <- c(
  here("results/supplement_tables_1_7.rds"),
  here("results/supplement_tables_8.rds"),
  here("results/supplement_tables_9_12.rds")
)

if (isTRUE(params$refresh) || !all(file.exists(rds_paths))) {
  rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript")
  for (s in table_scripts) {
    message("Running ", s)
    status <- system2(rscript, shQuote(here(s)), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
    if (status != 0) stop("Failed while running ", s)
  }
}

missing <- rds_paths[!file.exists(rds_paths)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing table inputs:\n  ", paste(missing, collapse = "\n  "),
       "\nRender with -P refresh:true, or run the table scripts first.")
}

legacy <- c(readRDS(rds_paths[1]), readRDS(rds_paths[2]), readRDS(rds_paths[3]))

## Emit a legacy S1-S12 table. `key` indexes into `legacy`.
supp_table <- function(key, size = 7) {
  legacy_flextable(legacy[[key]], fontsize_body = size, fontsize_header = size + 1)
}

## Effect-modification results (S13-S15)
emm <- load_emm_results()

## Human-readable section titles for the three EMM timepoints, keyed on
## the `timepoint` codes written by src/09.
emm_sections <- tibble::tribble(
  ~timepoint, ~number, ~title,
  "T2",    "S13", "Effect modification by pathogen infection, diarrhea, and fever on cytokine ratios at age 14 months",
  "T3",    "S14", "Effect modification by pathogen infection, diarrhea, and fever on cytokine ratios at age 28 months",
  "Delta", "S15", "Effect modification by pathogen infection, diarrhea, and fever on change in cytokine ratios between ages 14 and 28 months"
)
```

```{r consort-data}
#| include: false
consort <- read.csv(here("manuscript/consort-checklist.csv"),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
section_rows <- which(consort$row_type == "section")
consort_ft <- flextable(consort[, c("Item", "Description", "Reported in Section")]) %>%
  bold(i = section_rows, part = "body") %>%
  bg(i = section_rows, bg = "#E6E6E6", part = "body") %>%
  merge_h(i = section_rows, part = "body") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 1, part = "all") %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 0.7) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 5.5) %>%
  width(j = 3, width = 2.5)
```

# CONSORT Checklist

```{r}
consort_ft
```

## Figure S4

Unadjusted means and 95% confidence intervals by the control arm and N+WSH arms for individual cytokines and combined cytokine ratios at ages 14 and 28 months. The ratio is plotted prior to log-transformation for more comparable values to the constituent biomarkers, but the ratio was log-transformed prior to analysis.

```{r}

```

```{r emm-sections}
#| output: asis

## S13-S15: one subsection per (timepoint, modifier). Which modifiers
## appear is decided in src/09 by the temporality assignment and the
## sparse-cell screen - see the header of _emm_helpers.R. Anything not
## estimable never reaches this file, so the numbering here follows
## whatever survived.

for (s in seq_len(nrow(emm_sections))) {
  tp <- emm_sections$timepoint[s]
  df_tp <- emm %>% filter(timepoint == tp)
  if (nrow(df_tp) == 0) next

  cat("\n\n# Table ", emm_sections$number[s], ". ",
      emm_sections$title[s], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(emm_intro_text(emm_sections$title[s]), "\n\n", sep = "")

  idx <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(modifier_lut))) {
    V_code   <- modifier_lut$V[i]
    df_mod   <- df_tp %>% filter(V == V_code)
    if (nrow(df_mod) == 0) next

    ft <- build_modifier_table(df_mod)
    if (is.null(ft)) next

    idx <- idx + 1
    cat("\n\n## Table ", emm_sections$number[s], "-", idx,
        ". Effect modification by ", modifier_heading(V_code, tp), ".\n\n",
        sep = "")
    cat(knitr::knit_print(ft))

    note <- modifier_note(V_code, tp)
    if (!is.na(note) && nzchar(note)) cat("\n\n", note, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
